title: Ledger 8 — Human signal (did the principal agree?)
description: arch §5 L8: edits, overrides, endorsements/rejections, escalation outcomes; access-controlled (§8.6). Minimization (V3/SE-2): records OUTCOMES, never inlines edited content — diffs live in an erasable side-store, the chain hashes references. CN-1: ✓/✗ counted only from the principal's authenticated identity; unattributed signals logged, never counted.

signal_type.description: What kind of human signal this is

artifact_ref.description: The deliverable/action the signal is about

principal_id.description: Authenticated identity of the signaling principal (CN-1 — load-bearing: envelope widening consumes only principal-attributed records)

attribution.description: CN-1: unattributed signals are logged with this mark and never counted toward acceptance or envelope widening

outcome.description: The signal outcome (e.g. accepted, rejected, edited-lightly, edited-heavily) — outcomes, not content (V3)

unprompted.description: Provenance of the deliverable this signal is about: true = the agent produced it unprompted (initiative); false/absent = the principal asked for it. The initiative floor counts ONLY unprompted=true records — prompted work never inflates the floor (T6).

edit_distance_normalized.description: For edits: normalized edit distance (≤0.2 = lightly edited, R-11); null when not an edit

diff_ref.description: SE-2: reference into the erasable diff side-store; erasure crypto-shreds the referenced content while chain verification of adjacent records survives

harvest.description: How the signal was captured (SE-1: deterministic, no language model in the evidence path; OB-4: point-in-time, removals never retract)
